name: The Fable
description: A legendary hitman trained to become the world's best assassin is asked to lay low for a year by the head of his crime family.

videos.title: Moving
videos.overview: The invincible hitman, Fable, is ordered by the boss to live an ordinary life in Osaka for a year.

videos.title: A Wonderful Night
videos.overview: Akira and Yoko start their new life in Osaka, but trouble always seems to find them.

videos.title: Tag
videos.overview: Akira runs the risk of disobeying orders while minding his own business.

videos.title: Chatting About Life
videos.overview: Sparks fly between Akira, who wants to live in peace, and Ebihara, who wants the hitman out.

videos.title: You Listening to Me?!
videos.overview: In his quest to live an ordinary life, Akira begins the seemingly impossible task of finding a job.

videos.title: Prison Release Jamboree
videos.overview: Kojima becomes increasingly resentful at changes to the Maguro Group while he was in prison.

videos.title: Realist
videos.overview: With growing frustration, Kojima takes advantage of Ebihara's absence to make his move.

videos.title: Because I'm...You know!
videos.overview: Yoko sets her sights on a playboy womanizer who shows up at the bar where she hangs out.

videos.title: You Mean a Hitman...?
videos.overview: As Kojima's rampage escalates, Ebihara tries to get Akira to keep an eye on him.

videos.title: The Phantom of the Balcony
videos.overview: When Akira finds out that Misaki is in trouble, he goes into action to get her out of it.

videos.title: The Fated Day
videos.overview: Akira, Yoko, Kojima, and Sunagawa all prepare for what will be an explosive encounter.

videos.title: There's Always Someone Better
videos.overview: Hindered by his order not to kill, Akira still puts his rescue plan into motion.

videos.title: Aniki...Aniki...
videos.overview: Akira returns with Kojima, but now Ebihara faces a hard decision to keep the peace of the Group.

videos.title: I Love You, Nii-san!
videos.overview: Akira lets Kuroshio, who knows the truth about Fable, tag along for a two-night survival adventure.

videos.title: Survival Traning?
videos.overview: Akira and Kuroshio's survival adventure in the mountains drives Kuroshio to the edge of sanity.

videos.title: Mountaineer Man
videos.overview: One battleground, the woods, the other, a bar. Both will echo with sounds of fierce combat tonight.

videos.title: Rei Utsubo
videos.overview: From a Taihei detective agency, a dark force is at work, disturbing Akira's peaceful life.

videos.title: Cheerio
videos.overview: Utsubo and his associates approach Misaki as they proceed with their nefarious plans.

videos.title: Lies and Falsehoods
videos.overview: Akira finds out a surprising fact during a delivery, and Utsubo and his crew make their next move.

videos.title: 24 Hours
videos.overview: Utsubo exposes Kainuma's stalking, causing Kainuma to turn his ire on Misaki.

videos.title: The ABCs of Villainy
videos.overview: After discovering who Fable is, Utsubo begins working out a plan to kill Akira.

videos.title: Doorstep Man
videos.overview: Utsubo and Suzuki put into motion their carefully laid plans to kill Fable, their foe.

videos.title: Horn
videos.overview: Akira proves harder than expected to kill, and Utsubo runs into trouble preparing the next trap.

videos.title: Starry Sky Lullaby
videos.overview: Suzuki and Akira work desperately to save Hinako, and Utsubo puts his final plan into action.

videos.title: Imagination Man
videos.overview: Isaki arranges for a getaway car but runs into a snag. Otherwise, life goes on for everyone else.
